revision: implementation repairs 5c96af6, 139c369, and the final in-tree output-symlink guard

invariant.portable_principle: A lexical concept scan surfaces retired prose and identifier candidates; TypeScript completion additionally requires host-pinned Compiler API evidence with explicit symbol authority and blocking diagnostics.
invariant.python_or_framework_mechanism: Read-only glossary lifecycle report plus two coupled detector bands.
invariant.typescript_mechanism: Host-pinned TypeScript Compiler API resolves exact glossary identifiers and emits persistent structured evidence.
explicit_non_goals: Whole-project type-check success as the rename condition
Dynamic behavior, JSX runtime, or IDE-codemod safety proof
A shared TypeScript platform without a second accepted consumer

authority_contract.accepted_declarations: Matching top-level exported variable, function, class, interface, type alias, or enum declarations only.
completion: at least one new exported declaration
zero config, parse, or candidate/name/module/member resolution diagnostics

tooling.fixture_version: typescript 5.9.3 pinned in package.json and package-lock.json
tooling.missing_tool_behavior: Structured status=unavailable plus incomplete verdict when TypeScript is missing or resolves outside the project root; no source write
tooling.diagnostic_behavior: Invalid tsconfig, all parse diagnostics, and semantic errors affecting a candidate or codes 2304/2305/2307/2552 block certification.
tooling.closure_mode: One stock skills@1.5.19 --copy command projects the exact coupled pair to .agents/skills/{rename-concept,find-concept-divergence}; the installed sibling scanner is the lexical authority.

evidence_model.persistent_output: --output reports/rename-concept/assessment.json contains lifecycle, lexical candidate, compiler, diagnostic, verdict, and open-item evidence; its logical path must stay inside that report subtree and every existing final or ancestor symlink component is rejected before mkdir/write, including in-tree aliases such as reports -> src.

principles: contained assessment output writes with no final or ancestor symlink components
no directory symlink traversal, including direct targets and descendants
must_scan: a host nested under an ancestor named node_modules
root-contained .ts and .tsx sources in the coupled scanner default surface

focused_cases: Copied python -I -S dirty TS/TSX assessment and source immutability

Absolute and relative contained assessment output plus report-root, source/source-symlink, external/traversal, and every final/ancestor symlink rejection without writes, including reports -> src source-overwrite prevention
Direct ignored targets, direct internal directory symlink or descendant, excluded logical symlink alias, and escaped symlink exclusion; ordinary contained target still scans
Stock documented one-command exact-two skill install/preflight/assess journey with COMPLETE clean host report
Missing host TypeScript compiler blocks with structured evidence
Ancestor-resolved TypeScript is rejected as non-host evidence
Missing copied detector stays inconclusive without source-tree fallback
Invalid syntax produces blocking parse diagnostics
tests.regression_result: 29 passed: TypeScript suite plus B1 portability, skill metadata, perimeter, and skill smoke tests.

reuse_decision.rationale: The accepted detector already owns the exact two lexical bands; copying it would create a drifting second authority. The Compiler API remains family-local.

residual_risks: Only exact glossary names and aliases are evaluated.
Unrelated semantic diagnostics do not block completion by design.
Codemod mutation remains intentionally out of scope.
